name: evercraft
description: Inspect authorized public websites through Evercraft's bounded, evidence-backed read-only website inspector.

interface.longDescription: Inspect a public website you own, administer, or have permission to review. Evercraft returns bounded, evidence-backed HTTP and on-page signals with explicit limitations. It does not modify the site, access private networks, create payments, or perform other consequential actions.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my public website and show me the basic signals that need attention.
Check my website for missing title, description, headings, canonical, and contact signals.
Inspect my homepage for basic on-page and conversion signals.
